name: Popular Snake 7
author: Yaseen549
description: Dark rounded gray password input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks: On focus, outline-color becomes #ffffff, background-color changes from #212121 to #212121, text color changes to #e8e8e8.
html: <input type="password" name="text" class="input" placeholder="Enter your password!">
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Popular Snake 7</title>
<style>
/* Popular Snake 7 by Yaseen549 — https://uiverse.io/Yaseen549/popular-snake-7 */
.input {
 border: 2px solid #e8e8e8;
 padding: 15px;
 border-radius: 10px;
 background-color: #212121;
 font-size: small;
 font-weight: bold;
 text-align: center;
}

.input:focus {
 outline-color: white;
 background-color: #212121;
 color: #e8e8e8;
 box-shadow: 5px 5px #888888;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input type="password" name="text" class="input" placeholder="Enter your password!">

</body>
</html>
